_about.what: Which evidence streams make the weights the scorer uses (read by scoring/derive_weights.py).

streams.judgement: AHP pairwise judgements: the team members' group judgements (scoring/expert_weights.json) where they exist and are consistent, otherwise the AI session's judgements (scoring/ahp_judgements.json).
streams.data: Relative importance of conditions in NASA measurements (scoring/data_weights.json), pooled into the judgement weights of the dimensions it covers.

_about.status: apply true since config 1.3.0 (2026-11-14 20:06 KST, the human lead's decision): the suppression weights pool the AI session's AHP judgements with the NASA FLEX data stream; prevention and detection keep the AHP weights, because no NASA table records a response for them. When team members' judgements arrive (scoring/expert_weights.json), rerun derive_weights.py --write; that also needs the human lead's decision.

suppression.why: FLEX (Flame Extinguishment Experiment) is the NASA suppression data set with a measured extinction response. It covers oxygen, pressure, diluent and fuel; it says nothing about flow (quiescent droplets), shape or the purpose of a study, so those keep their judgement weights. lambda 0.5 gives judgement and data equal say.
